AIG rebuilt its Excess & Surplus (E&S) commercial underwriting on Palantir Foundry/AIP with generative-AI 'logic agents' (using Anthropic Claude for data extraction), enabling underwriters to review 100% of incoming private/non-profit financial-lines submissions without adding staff and cutting parts of the underwriting cycle from about one month to one day. [Palantir AIP / Foundry + Anthropic Claude]
deployments_detail.value: Reviews 100% of private/non-profit financial-lines submissions without adding underwriters; parts of underwriting cut from ~1 month to 1 day; targeting 500,000+ E&S submissions and $4B new premium by 2030

deployments_detail.use: Maven Smart System: AI/ML-powered battlespace-awareness platform integrated with Palantir AIP that analyzes drone footage, satellite imagery and intelligence to detect threats, track targets and support joint fires and targeting for the U.S. military; expanded across military services and slated to become an official program of record. [Palantir AIP / Maven Smart System]

NHS Federated Data Platform: Palantir Foundry/AIP-based platform connecting disparate NHS hospital-trust data, with AI tools being deployed for theatre/operating-room scheduling, patient triage and discharge planning across NHS England. [Palantir Foundry / AIP]

Cleveland Clinic Virtual Command Center: Palantir Foundry-based system using machine learning and AI to forecast patient admissions/discharges/transfers, predict patient supply and demand, and drive proactive, capacity-informed nurse staffing and scheduling across hospitals. [Palantir Foundry]

Tampa General Hospital selected Palantir AIP as the core analytics/AI platform to power connected care-coordination workflows (patient flow, staffing, discharge and transfer management) across the health system. [Palantir AIP]

Warp Speed manufacturing OS: AI-native, Ontology-based manufacturing operating system deployed by industrial customers (e.g., Ursa Major for rocket propulsion production, L3Harris for defense factory production) to unify PLM/ERP/MES/CRM data and automate production planning and MRP. [Palantir Warp Speed / AIP]
deployments_detail.value: Ursa Major projects 10,000-15,000 engineering hours saved annually
